dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible 2D geometric narrowing of the body from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-reflectance pixels on the left longitudinal plane and light-grey shadow on the right longitudinal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Small localized clusters of dark pixels at the distal end of the visible peduncle.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the white primary pigment and the textured dark areas at the posterior tip.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct small, dark point disruptions (pitting) visible on the skin surface at the posterior-most section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized epidermal pitting and irregular texture at the posterior tip of the visible body.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp, linear dorsal ridge that creates a high-contrast longitudinal shadow boundary along the center of the body.
